changelog: fix: ONT 16S ran against a different Emu database from the one selected and recorded. main.py picked the Emu database as ont_db_path, else emu_db_mar2026 / emu_silva / any emu_* from db_paths.json, and only then the selection, so whenever emu_db_mar2026 existed it was used regardless of the choice. Job Detail and run_params.json showed the selected database (e.g. emu_silva/sequences.fasta) while the Emu command in the log used emu_db_mar2026. The selected database now wins when it is an Emu database (has taxonomy.tsv); the auto-lookup is only a fallback for a selection that is not, and the log says which database was used and why. Needs a backend restart.

previous.changelog: fix: ClusterTree + bar (12b): the tree's branches ran through the sample names. The names were drawn at the leaf tips with hjust=1, which puts the text back over the tree's own branches. They are now the bar panel's axis labels, between the tree and the bars, with a gap after the tips. The tree is computed directly from hclust (no ggdendro), and both panels use the same fixed row range so each leaf lines up with its bar. ggdendro is no longer needed for this figure. Verified by rendering the figure in R from the U2BI-139 tables.
